articles.title: Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and BlackRock on Deck to Report Earnings
articles.mainIdea: Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and BlackRock on Deck to Report Earnings
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and BlackRock on Deck to Report Earnings. Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and BlackRock are slated to release fourth-quarter earnings on Thursday after a tough day for investors in the financial sector. Investors will be able to parse results from BlackRock, the world’s largest asset manager, to learn how fee growth and fund flow metrics were in the quarter, particularly across fixed-income funds. UBS analyst Michael Brown noted in a report this week that BlackRock typically offers guidance on organic base fee growth, core expenses, its tax rate, and buybacks as part of fourth-quarter earnings. Related tickers mentioned: BLK, GS, MS-PQ, ^GSPC.

articles.title: Bank sell-off is more about valuation than earnings performances
articles.mainIdea: Bank sell-off is more about valuation than earnings performances
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Bank sell-off is more about valuation than earnings performances. Bank stocks slid lower in Wednesday's session after Wells Fargo (WFC), Citigroup (C), Bank of America (BAC), and JPMorgan Chase (JPM) reported their latest earnings results this week. Morgan Stanley (MS) and Goldman Sachs (GS) also tick lower ahead of their earnings releases due out on Thursday. S&P Global Market Intelligence director of financial institutions research Nathan Stovall addresses the valuation concerns tied to the banking sector that may be dragging the financial sector down despite generally strong results.
